name: pail-verify
description: Quint models of pail's publish protocol, store and branch policy, and the tools that check them

scripts.compile: npm run compile:publish && npm run compile:store && npm run compile:policy && npm run compile:pr && npm run compile:events
scripts.compile:policy: quint-refinements compile policy_scenarios.qnt --module policyScenarios --compact --artifact policy/policy-refinements.json --rust ../tests/policy_refinement/generated.rs --go policy/pailpolicy_refinement_gen_test.go --go-package gateway
scripts.check: npm run compile:publish -- --check && npm run compile:store -- --check && npm run compile:policy -- --check && npm run compile:pr -- --check && npm run compile:events -- --check
scripts.test: quint test store_scenarios.qnt --main=storeScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test scenarios.qnt --main=scenarios --match='Run$' && quint test policy_scenarios.qnt --main=policyScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test pr_scenarios.qnt --main=prScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test actions/actions_scenarios.qnt --main=actionsScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test events/events_scenarios.qnt --main=eventsScenarios --match='Run$'
scripts.simulate: quint run pail.qnt --main=pail --invariant=safety --max-steps=100 --max-samples=20000 && quint run pail.qnt --main=pail --step=contendStep --invariant=safety --max-steps=60 --max-samples=20000 && npm run simulate:pr && npm run simulate:actions && npm run simulate:events
scripts.witness: for inv in gcNeverDeletesAPack gcNeverDeletesAChunk branchHasNoHugeFile; do quint run pail.qnt --main=pail --invariant=$inv --max-steps=100 --max-samples=200000 | grep -q '^\[violation\]' || { echo "never reached: $inv"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.witness:pr: for inv in neverMerged neverOutdated neverStale; do quint run pr_sim.qnt --main=prSim --init=simInit --step=simStep --invariant=$inv --max-steps=60 --max-samples=50000 | grep -q '^\[violation\]' || { echo "never reached: $inv"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.witness:actions: for inv in neverRequeued neverCancelled neverRerun neverApproved neverSkipped neverLostWake neverPolled; do quint run actions/actions_sim.qnt --main=actionsSim --init=simInit --step=simStep --invariant=$inv --max-steps=60 --max-samples=50000 | grep -q '^\[violation\]' || { echo "never reached: $inv"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.witness:events: for inv in neverDeleted neverRepeated neverResumed neverRescued neverDropped; do quint run events/events_sim.qnt --main=eventsSim --init=simInit --step=simStep --invariant=$inv --max-steps=60 --max-samples=50000 | grep -q '^\[violation\]' || { echo "never reached: $inv"; exit 1; }; done
